title: No sandbox, no start
honesty: Built and tested. The check runs before an enforced Claude Code start and starts no agent. It is cooperative today and enforced where built.
analogy: A pilot's checklist before take off. The plane does not leave the gate until every item is ticked, and an item that cannot be ticked is named.
analogy_stops: A pilot reads the list and may skip it. This list runs in code before the helper starts, but only for an enforced Claude Code agent.
does_not: It does not start an agent: umwayi agent check only asks.
It does not check the sandbox of other platforms.
It does not prove that confinement works on a real run.
owner_check: Run umwayi agent check on your own enforced agent and read each line.
Check that a refusal names one word from the fixed list.
